label: Applying direct to a Hong Kong university as a non-local student (non-JUPAS), 2027

milestones.label: CUHK Advance Offer Round closes
milestones.note: If you miss it, the same application goes into the Regular Round.

milestones.label: PolyU Main Round closes
milestones.note: Rolling until 14 May 2027 if places remain.

milestones.label: CityU non-local application period
milestones.note: CityU's page blocks automated reading. Open it in a normal browser.

milestones.label: Other universities
milestones.note: HKBU, Lingnan, EdUHK, HKAPA and the self-financing universities each set their own dates. Not researched here.

supplementarySteps: Apply to each university on its own site, under international or non-local qualifications. JUPAS is the system for Hong Kong DSE students and is not yours.
Apply by the November rounds. The early rounds decide on predicted grades, and offers are conditional on the final diploma.

notes: The applicant group is non-eu because Hong Kong's categories are local and non-local. A Danish student is non-local, and EU status plays no part.
